get.description: The two roles with the number of non-deleted users in each, sorted by name.
Admins and customers with roles, lock state and customer ID. Filters: email, role, isLocked, emailConfirmed, includeDeleted.

post.description: Creates a confirmed Admin user with no password; a reset link is sent so the new Admin sets one.

get.description: Returns one user with roles, lock details and failed login count. Deleted users are returned anonymized with isDeleted true.

post.description: Admin lock until a date (or with no end) and revokes the user's sessions. You cannot lock yourself or the last active Admin (409 admin-safeguard).

put.description: Makes a non-customer user an Admin and revokes their sessions. Customers cannot become Admins (409 user-is-customer).

delete.description: Removes the Admin role and revokes the user's sessions. You cannot demote yourself or the last active Admin (409 admin-safeguard).

post.description: Removes any lock (admin or failed-logins) and resets the failed login count. No-op if not locked.

get.description: Paged audit entries, newest first (sort is ignored). Filters: entityType, entityId, userId, action, from (inclusive), to (exclusive). Personal data appears only as "changed". Each call is logged as a security event.

post.description: Checks the current password, sets the new one, revokes all refresh tokens and rotates the security stamp.
Confirms the email with the token from the confirmation link. Returns 204, also when already confirmed, and a generic 400 invalid-token otherwise.
Sends a reset link (valid 1 hour) to an existing, non-deleted account. Always returns 202 with the same message.
Returns an access token (15 min) and a refresh token. 401 invalid-credentials for a wrong password, unknown, locked or deleted account; 403 email-not-confirmed only after a correct password.
Revokes the given refresh token if it belongs to the caller. Always 204.
Revokes all the caller's refresh tokens and rotates the security stamp, so existing access tokens stop working within 30 seconds.

get.description: Returns the caller's user ID, email, confirmation state, roles and customer ID, read from the database.

post.description: Rotates the refresh token and returns a new pair. Reusing an old refresh token revokes the whole family and returns 401.
Creates an unconfirmed user, the Customer role and a customer record. Always returns 202 with the same message, so it does not reveal whether the email exists.
Sends a new confirmation link for an unconfirmed account. Always returns 202 with the same message.
Sets a new password with the reset token, confirms the email, clears a failed-logins lock and revokes all tokens. Generic 400 invalid-token on any token problem.
Creates a user with the Customer role (no password) and a customer record in one transaction; a reset link is sent so the customer sets a password. 409 duplicate-email.

get.description: Paged customer list. Filters: search (first name, last name, email), createdFrom (inclusive), createdTo (exclusive), includeDeleted.
Returns the caller's customer profile with its ETag. The customer ID comes from the token only; 404 when the record no longer exists.

put.description: Replaces the caller's first name, last name and phone. Requires If-Match: 428 when missing, 412 when stale. Email cannot be changed here.

post.description: Checks the current password (400 errors.currentPassword), then anonymizes and soft deletes the caller's customer and user and revokes all tokens. 409 customer-has-open-orders.
Places a Pending order for the caller (customer ID from the token only). 400 for an unknown product, 409 insufficient-stock or too-many-pending-orders. Returns 201 with Location and ETag.

get.description: Paged list of the caller's orders, newest first by default. Filters: status (repeatable), createdFrom (inclusive), createdTo (exclusive).
Returns one of the caller's orders with items and history, plus its ETag. Another customer's order returns 404.

post.description: Cancels one of the caller's Pending orders and returns its stock. The body is optional ({ reason }). 404 for another customer's order; 409 invalid-status-transition otherwise.

get.description: Returns one customer with its ETag. Deleted customers are 404 unless includeDeleted=true; they are then returned anonymized with isDeleted true.

put.description: Replaces first name, last name and phone (null clears). Requires If-Match: 428 when missing, 412 when stale. An absent or unchanged email is ignored; a different one returns 409 email-change-not-allowed.

delete.description: Anonymizes and soft deletes the customer and its user, and revokes their tokens, in one transaction. 409 customer-has-open-orders when a Pending, Confirmed or Shipped order exists.

get.description: Paged order history of one customer, newest first (sort is ignored). 404 for an unknown or deleted customer.

post.summary: Create an order for a customer
post.description: Creates a Pending order at current prices and reserves stock. 400 for an unknown customer or product, 409 insufficient-stock or too-many-pending-orders. Returns 201 with Location and ETag.

get.description: Paged order list, newest first by default. Filters: status (repeatable), customerId, createdFrom (inclusive), createdTo (exclusive), minTotal, maxTotal.
Returns one order with items, status history and the allowed next statuses, plus its ETag.

post.description: Cancels a Pending or Confirmed order and returns its stock. The body is optional ({ reason }). 409 invalid-status-transition otherwise.

put.summary: Replace the items of an order
put.description: Replaces all lines of a Pending order and adjusts stock. Requires If-Match: 428 when missing, 412 when stale. 409 invalid-order-state or insufficient-stock.

post.summary: Change the status of an order
post.description: Moves an order forward: Pending → Confirmed → Shipped → Completed. Other targets return 409 invalid-status-transition with allowedNextStatuses; use the cancel endpoint to cancel.

get.description: Paged product list. Filters: search (name or SKU), minPrice, maxPrice, inStock; includeDeleted is honoured for Admins only. Cached per role scope; Cache-Control: private, no-cache.

post.description: Creates a product (SKU stored upper-case). Returns 201 with Location and ETag; 409 duplicate-sku when an active product has the SKU.

get.description: Returns one product with its ETag. Deleted products are 404 unless an Admin sends includeDeleted=true. Cache-Control: private, no-cache.

put.description: Full replace. Requires If-Match with the current ETag: 428 when missing, 412 when stale. Returns the product with a new ETag; 409 duplicate-sku.

delete.description: Soft deletes the product; existing order lines are unchanged. 404 when unknown or already deleted.

post.description: Restores a soft-deleted product. 409 not-deleted when it is active; 409 duplicate-sku when another active product now has the SKU.

get.description: Paged active products with stock at or below the threshold (default from configuration), lowest stock first (sort is ignored).
Paged order summaries with customer name, line and unit counts. Same filters and sort as the order list. Deleted customers stay in the report (anonymized).
Order count, units and revenue per day, week (ISO, Monday) or month in UTC for Confirmed, Shipped and Completed orders. from and to are required, from < to, at most 366 days.
Best-selling products by units, then revenue, for Confirmed, Shipped and Completed orders in the range. top is 1-50 (default 10); not paged.
Anonymous so orchestrator probes work without a token. Checks the process only (no dependencies); always 200 { status: Healthy }. Not rate limited.

Anonymous so orchestrator probes work without a token. Checks PostgreSQL and Valkey (500 ms each): 200 Healthy, 200 Degraded (Valkey down), 503 Unhealthy (PostgreSQL down). Development adds per-check details. Not rate limited.

statusCode.description: the http status code sent to the client. default is 400.

message.description: the message for the error response

ErrorResponse.description: the dto used to send an error response to the client

JWTBearerAuth.description: Enter a JWT token to authorize the requests...
